authentic_sources.name: COCO 2017 Dataset (Clean Partitions outside Historical Option P)
authentic_sources.license: Per-image Flickr license verified via oEmbed (CC-BY 2.0, CC-BY-SA 2.0, CC-BY 3.0, CC-BY-SA 3.0, CC-BY 4.0, CC-BY-SA 4.0)
authentic_sources.license_audit_note: Do NOT assume all COCO images share a single license; Flickr source license must be verified per sample. NoDerivs strictly excluded.
authentic_sources.provenance_tracking: Flickr image ID, author name, Flickr URL, license name, license URL, date_captured
authentic_sources.authenticity_note: Pre-2017 capture prevents modern text-to-image AI artifacts; does not mathematically guarantee zero analog/digital editing.

authentic_sources.name: Wikimedia Commons Quality & Featured Photographic Works
authentic_sources.license: Creative Commons Attribution licenses permitting derivative works and redistribution (CC-BY, CC-BY-SA)
authentic_sources.license_audit_note: Requires artist attribution and record of page ID, creation date, and publication timestamp. NoDerivs strictly excluded.
authentic_sources.provenance_tracking: Wikimedia Commons page ID, title, artist name, source page URL, DateTimeOriginal, DateTime
authentic_sources.authenticity_note: High-resolution curated photography with verified creator metadata and explicit CC licensing permitting derivatives.

inpainting_tools.name: Stable Diffusion 2 Inpainting
inpainting_tools.execution_environment: Local GPU (if VRAM >= 8GB) or Google Colab T4 / A100 GPU

inpainting_tools.name: SDXL Inpainting 1.0
inpainting_tools.execution_environment: Google Colab T4 / A100 GPU (fp16 requires ~6.6GB VRAM; exceeds local 4GB GTX 1650)

orthogonal_allocation_matrix.description: 2x2 Orthogonal balanced allocation of inpainting tools across authentic sources to control designed factors (does NOT eliminate unobserved confounding).
orthogonal_allocation_matrix.stratum_preserving_replacement_rule: If a candidate in stratum (S, T) fails technical QC, content QC, or disjoint checks, it is replaced solely by the next pre-ordered candidate in the EXACT SAME stratum (S, T) from the buffer pool. Zero quota re-allocation between strata is permitted.

content_qc_protocol.prohibition: Zero detector scores may be rendered on content QC sheets (Detector Isolation Invariant).
criteria: Inpainted object semantically satisfies the assigned prompt category.
No severe visual boundary tearing or unnatural seam artifacts.
Unmodified background outside the request mask remains photorealistic and consistent.
